council.method: Each seat votes by a fixed rule on database values. A seat with no data abstains. There is no blended score.

rules.value: P/E below {pe_bullish_below} bullish, below {pe_neutral_below} neutral, else bearish. No or negative earnings: abstains.
rules.quality: ROE above {roe_bullish_above}% bullish, above {roe_neutral_above}% neutral, else bearish.
rules.income: Dividend yield above {yield_bullish_above}% bullish, above {yield_neutral_above}% neutral, else bearish. No dividend: abstains.
rules.momentum: Trend regime above {regime_bullish_above} with the 50-day average above the 200-day bullish, above {regime_neutral_above} neutral, else bearish.
rules.risk: 1-year volatility below {vol_bullish_below}% with a yield above {yield_bullish_above}% bullish, below {vol_neutral_below}% neutral, else bearish.
rules.news: Rated news of the last {window_days} days: a majority positive bullish, a majority negative bearish, otherwise neutral. No rated news: abstains.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.lead: How the council votes, where the data comes from and how we decide it is fresh. The rules and numbers on this page are read from the code and database the terminal runs on.

council.title: How the council votes
council.body: Each seat applies one fixed rule to figures from our database and votes bullish, neutral or bearish. A seat without the data it needs abstains; nothing is estimated. There is no blended score: you see every seat, its inputs and the count of votes.

data.title: Where the data comes from
data.body: Every night a pipeline collects prices, financial statements, ratios, dividends, disclosures and news for each listed equity from public market sources and writes them to our database. The terminal reads that database directly and never fills a gap with an estimate: missing data is labelled as missing.
data.run: The nightly run starts at <n>{time}</n> UTC.

fresh.title: How we decide data is fresh
fresh.body: Every dataset has an allowed age. A panel's light is green while its data is within that age, amber once it is older, and grey when we have no date for it. Prices and technical indicators age in trading days, so a weekend is never late. News and disclosures age from the date of their newest item, and also turn amber when the nightly fetch is late. Datasets other than prices and technical indicators age in calendar days.
fresh.fallback: An equity without a freshness record falls back to the price rule: <n>{days}</n> trading days.

limits.title: What AlphaCouncil is not
limits.body: AlphaCouncil is research software. It is not investment advice, not a broker and does not execute trades. Council votes and Copilot answers are rule outputs and summaries of our data, not recommendations. Read the <link>AI and financial disclaimer</link>.
